final_draft.answer: Two. Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: The approved answer (CC8.1, owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-16) matches the live branch protection setting on harborlight/app, checked at 2026-11-16T17:02:51Z: main is protected, 2 approving reviews are required, and the rule applies to administrators. Both sources cover only harborlight/app. If the customer is asking about other repositories, they would need to be checked separately.
